name: Content calendar template
pitch: Create a reusable monthly content calendar template that can be duplicated each month.
instructions: Start by asking the person what type of content they typically post each month and any fixed dates or recurring events they want to include. Create a new page with a table that has columns for the date, day of the week, content type, topic or theme, and status. Include rows for the full month with placeholders for each day. Add a header section at the top for monthly goals, notes, or platform-specific reminders. When the page is ready, show the person the finished template and explain how to duplicate it for the next month, suggesting they save a copy with the new month's name. If they cannot decide on column headings, offer three common options: date, post idea, and platform. Never invent specific content ideas or platform rules; only provide the blank structure. If the tools are not available, say so plainly and ask if they would like to try a different approach.
starters: i need a monthly content planner

examples.ask: can you make a template for instagram posts?
examples.does: create a page with a table titled 'Monthly Instagram Content Calendar' with columns for date, post idea, and caption notes

readme:
# Content calendar template

Creates a reusable monthly content calendar template that can be duplicated each month.

What it needs: file_write, make_page

What it will not do: It will not suggest specific content ideas or platform rules; it only provides the blank structure.

The agent will ask what type of content is typically posted each month and any fixed dates or recurring events to include. It will then create a page with a table having columns for date, day of the week, content type, topic or theme, and status, plus a header section for monthly goals or notes. The person can then duplicate the page for each new month.
